study: datagen_v1 - data-driven discovery: strategies created from the lab's own data, selected on old data

engine.doc:
(fill model "dg1", part of the cost-model key): every rule is an event rule with a FIXED exit, no stop, no
target, no optimisation. Rs 1 lakh per stock trade (whole shares at the entry price), index futures 1 lot (2026 lots,
sim.LOT_SIZES), slippage 2 bps per side for stocks / 1 bps for index futures against us on both fills (5 / 2.5 bps
stress), costs = costs.round_trip_cost (2026 Zerodha schedule): equity_mis intraday, equity_cnc delivery longs,
future for stock / index futures (stock futures simulated on the cash price, like attention.py). At most 10 entries
per candidate per day (largest rank first, ties by symbol), one open position per symbol and candidate.
  m_intra(a, b)  minute: enter at field a's bar open, exit at field b's bar open of the same session
  m_on           minute: enter at the 15:21 bar open, exit at the next session's 09:15 auction print
  m_hold(h)      minute: enter at the 15:21 open, exit at the 15:21 open h sessions later
  d_hold(h)      daily: decided in the evening of t, enter at the open of t+1, exit at the close of t+h (h = 1: the
                 same session's close); a hold that would pass the period end exits at the period's last close
  i_hold(h)      NIFTY 50 official daily bars as the index future, as d_hold
  i_on           index minute bars: 15:21 open -> next 09:15 open
Exclusions: daily = events_daily's corporate-action / unexplained-gap list (events_data.ca_excluded rule) and the
point-in-time universe gate (member on the decision day; product "fut" also needs a listed stock future that day);
minute = protocol_min_oos's dirty-link rule (old era) and ltr.CA_GAPS (2023-26), special sessions (median bar count
< 300) on the entry / exit day, a session whose previous calendar session is missing for gap rules, an overnight
exit beyond the period.

selection.gates: DISCOVERY: net > 0 in H1 and H2; PF >= 1.15; trades >= 150 intraday / 60 positional in EACH half; top symbol <= 35 % of net (not index); at 5 bps (index 2.5) net > 0 in H1 and H2
selection.rank: passers by DSR of the DISCOVERY daily net P&L, N = n_search + 2542, V = max(robust (1.4826 MAD)^2 of the n_search DISCOVERY daily Sharpes, median 1/(T-1))
selection.full_table: every candidate's DISCOVERY row is reported and appended to trials_v2.csv

validation: protocol.evaluate(screen_only=True) on calendar_3y: protocol.screen on 2023-11-10..2025-12-16, once (validation.json is never recomputed)
final: protocol.evaluate one-look FINAL for validation passers (ledger <datagen>/final_ledger.json); CONFIRMED = net > 0 and PF >= 1.05

proof.definition: PROVEN = VALIDATION screen passed AND FINAL CONFIRMED AND DSR >= 0.95 of the full-history daily net P&L (DISCOVERY start .. FINAL end) at N_full = (2023-26 variants in trials_v2.csv before this study, 2542) + n_search and the selection V AND, for long-biased rules (>= 70 % longs), the 95 % date-clustered bootstrap CI of the mean per-trade excess over NIFTY 50 on VALIDATION + FINAL above 0 AND the candidate's VALIDATION + FINAL net above the 95th percentile of 50 placebos AND every planted-edge control (p >= 0.6) detected by the DISCOVERY gates
proof.report_only: DSR with the ledger's robust V and the 1/(T-1) floor; DSR on VALIDATION + FINAL only; 5 bps; Rs 10 lakh account (capital.py, Rs 1 lakh per position)

controls.shuffle: 5 seeds: every candidate's trigger cells permuted across dates within symbol in DISCOVERY, the selection gates re-applied: expected vs observed passers
controls.placebo: 50 seeds per carried candidate and period: same count, random eligible cells, same long share

excluded_by_design.auction fade with entry and exit inside: neighbours of the proven AUC-FADE-2PCT / 3PCT (not new)
excluded_by_design.high-volume UP-day overnight long: the proven SWING-ATTN-ON-3X and its threshold neighbours (not new)
excluded_by_design.index-weight changes: NIFTY 50 / 100 reviews give < 60 events in VALIDATION (flows study: 37): cannot pass
excluded_by_design.expiry-day intraday index trades: < 150 index expiry sessions in VALIDATION: the intraday minimum cannot be met
excluded_by_design.MWPL proximity: no per-stock market-wide-position-limit series in the lab's data (only the ban list)
excluded_by_design.VIX term structure: no India VIX futures data in the lab
excluded_by_design.options: no candidate trades options; nothing uses VIX-modelled option prices

candidates.rule_doc:
A: opening-auction gap and the 09:15-09:20 path. go = the first five minutes confirm the gap (same sign as the
gap): trade with the gap; revfollow = they moved against it: trade against it; fade_day = fade from the auction.
candidates.story: Opening call-auction imbalances overshoot; whether the first five minutes confirm or reverse the gap tells information (continues) from imbalance (reverts).

candidates.rule_doc:
E: delivery % >= its 20-session mean + pp points on >= 2 x volume with a >= 2 % move: up -> long (genuine
accumulation), down -> short (genuine distribution).
candidates.story: Delivery % separates investors who take shares home from intraday speculators: a delivery-heavy move is informed and drifts; a delivery-light spike is churn and fades.

candidates.rule_doc:
F: FII net index-futures position (long - short contracts) changes by >= z standard deviations (previous 250
daily changes) in a day: follow the FIIs on NIFTY.
candidates.story: FIIs are the large, informed index-futures players; retail (Client) positioning is the contrarian side.

candidates.rule_doc:
G: F&O ban list. entry = the first trade date in the ban (the file of t+1 lists it, t's did not); exit = the
first trade date out of it. Decided in the evening of t (t+1's ban file is published after t's close), entered at
t+1's open.
candidates.story: The F&O ban forbids new positions until OI falls below 80 % of the market-wide limit: entry forces unwinding of a crowded trade; exit re-opens speculation.

candidates.rule_doc:
H: stock-futures OI change vs price change on the day (|move| >= 2 %, |OI change| >= thr): long build-up
(price up, OI up) -> long; short build-up (down, up) -> short; short covering (up, OI down) -> short (a forced move
fades); long unwinding (down, down) -> long.
candidates.story: Futures OI tells new positions from closed ones: build-ups are new informed money (continue), short covering / long unwinding are forced closes (revert).

candidates.rule_doc:
K: split / bonus. runup = buy at the open after the session the action became known, sell at the close before
the ex-date (1..40 sessions); post = buy at the ex-date open (known before), hold 20 sessions.
candidates.story: Splits / bonuses draw retail attention to 'cheaper' shares; dividend-capture demand lifts cum-dividend prices.
